NBC News on Instagram: "The four crew members of NASA's Artemis II moon mission have returned to Earth this evening, splashing down in the Pacific Ocean at 8:07 p.m. ET.

After the landing, NASA plans to extract the astronauts from the Orion spacecraft one by one and fly them via helicopter to a U.S. Navy ship.

During the 10-day Artemis II mission, the crew became the first humans to travel toward the moon in more than 50 years, and they set a new record for the farthest distance ever traveled from Earth. The astronauts were also the first to launch on NASA’s giant Space Launch System rocket and to travel onboard the Orion spacecraft.

Get live updates at the link in bio."
